name: Ingrid
source:
She is an exchange student miko from Germany. She is studying Japanese priestesses for her research on magic.

She has blond hair, blue eyes, and the appearance of a Western doll, but she is a genius and not very sociable. She prides herself on being born into a venerable family of wizards.

She is terrible at swimming, which is a secret complex of hers. Her favorite food is gummy candies, but she has a hard time finding them in the village where the story takes place.

The tool she uses to exorcise spirits is "Kottenforst cane," which she uses to remove the spirits of the dead.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko2.htm]official site[/url]]
